ledger_postings_mismatched_idx.name: ledger_postings_mismatched_idx
ledger_postings_mismatched_idx.where:
("ledger_postings"."resolution" is not null and ("ledger_postings"."state" = 'refused'
    or ("ledger_postings"."resolution" = 'capture' and "ledger_postings"."state" = 'voided')
    or ("ledger_postings"."resolution" = 'void' and "ledger_postings"."state" = 'posted')))

ledger_postings_state_shape.name: ledger_postings_state_shape
ledger_postings_state_shape.value:
("ledger_postings"."state" = 'created'
          and "ledger_postings"."journal_ref" is null and "ledger_postings"."resolution_ref" is null and "ledger_postings"."error_code" is null)
        or ("ledger_postings"."state" = 'pending'
          and "ledger_postings"."journal_ref" is not null and "ledger_postings"."resolution_ref" is null and "ledger_postings"."error_code" is null)
        or ("ledger_postings"."state" = 'posted'
          and "ledger_postings"."journal_ref" is not null and "ledger_postings"."error_code" is null
          and ("ledger_postings"."resolution_ref" is not null) = "ledger_postings"."pending")
        or ("ledger_postings"."state" = 'voided'
          and "ledger_postings"."journal_ref" is not null and "ledger_postings"."resolution_ref" is not null and "ledger_postings"."error_code" is null)
        or ("ledger_postings"."state" = 'refused'
          and "ledger_postings"."error_code" is not null and "ledger_postings"."resolution_ref" is null)

ledger_postings_resolution_shape.name: ledger_postings_resolution_shape
ledger_postings_resolution_shape.value:
("ledger_postings"."resolution" is null or ("ledger_postings"."pending" and "ledger_postings"."state" <> 'created'))
        and (not "ledger_postings"."pending" or "ledger_postings"."state" not in ('posted', 'voided') or "ledger_postings"."resolution" is not null)

payment_links_description_valid.name: payment_links_description_valid
payment_links_description_valid.value: "payment_links"."description" is null or (char_length("payment_links"."description") between 1 and 500 and "payment_links"."description" !~ '^[\t\n\v\f\r \u00a0\u1680\u2000-\u200a\u2028\u2029\u202f\u205f\u3000\ufeff]|[\t\n\v\f\r \u00a0\u1680\u2000-\u200a\u2028\u2029\u202f\u205f\u3000\ufeff]$')

payment_links_pricing_settings.name: payment_links_pricing_settings
payment_links_pricing_settings.value:
case "payment_links"."pricing_mode"
        when 'fixed' then "payment_links"."amount" is not null
          and "payment_links"."suggested_amount" is null
          and "payment_links"."minimum_amount" is null
          and "payment_links"."maximum_amount" is null
        else "payment_links"."amount" is null
      end

payment_links_minimum_within_maximum.name: payment_links_minimum_within_maximum
payment_links_minimum_within_maximum.value: "payment_links"."minimum_amount" is null or "payment_links"."maximum_amount" is null or "payment_links"."minimum_amount" <= "payment_links"."maximum_amount"

payment_links_suggested_within_bounds.name: payment_links_suggested_within_bounds
payment_links_suggested_within_bounds.value:
"payment_links"."suggested_amount" is null or (
        ("payment_links"."minimum_amount" is null or "payment_links"."suggested_amount" >= "payment_links"."minimum_amount")
        and ("payment_links"."maximum_amount" is null or "payment_links"."suggested_amount" <= "payment_links"."maximum_amount")
      )

payouts_sent_with_status.name: payouts_sent_with_status
payouts_sent_with_status.value:
("payouts"."status" in ('created', 'requested', 'held', 'rejected', 'cancelled', 'expired')
          and "payouts"."sent_at" is null and "payouts"."provider_ref" is null)
        or ("payouts"."status" in ('sent', 'paid') and "payouts"."sent_at" is not null)
        or "payouts"."status" in ('failed', 'attention')
